name: post.ig_media
description: The Instagram media id a post went out as, or nothing when its Instagram job is not live. Internal: for packages/connect only, which reads the collaborators' invites from Instagram with it.
sql: select jsonb_build_object('mediaId', j.external_id) as result from brandbase.post_jobs j where j.post_id = :id and j.brand_id = :brand and j.channel = 'ig' and j.status = 'live' and j.external_id is not null
